objective: Fix the five non-blocking review leftovers on release/0.2.1/fix/followups in /home/user/holyagent-fix-followups.
scope: 1. packages/runtime/src/cli/workflow-check.ts (~1944): a single non-global `s = s.replace('a','xyz')` outside any loop is now refused, though the base allowed it. Restore it: apply the textual growth rule to replaceAll, and to replace only with a global regex, or only inside a loop or function body, whichever is the smaller rule that keeps the existing tests.

2. workflow-check.ts (~1919-1932): a join is judged only when its receiver is a direct `.split(literal)` call. Close `const p = s.split(''); s = p.join('--')`, `s = [...s].join('--')` and `s = Array.from(s).join('--')` inside a loop by tracing the join receiver through a binding, spread and Array.from back to the grown value. Real root scripts call `.join('\n')` on arrays of lines all the time, so judge only a join whose receiver derives from the binding being reassigned.

3. workflow-check.ts (~1908-1918): textsOf stops at parameters and conditionals. Make a conditional contribute both branches. For a replacement text that is not known (such as a function parameter, as in `const g=(s,r)=>s.replaceAll('a',r)`), refuse the call when it is inside a loop or a function body and the text does not come from args. Skip this part if it would refuse a real root script, and say so.

4. scripts/vendor.ts (~770): Promise.all downloads every missing archive before installing any, so one failure discards the downloads that succeeded. Install each archive once its own download and pin check succeed, keep the archives that succeeded, and still exit non-zero naming every failed one. A failed or partial download must never be pinned or installed. Use the composition the file already uses.

5. docs/development.md: the 64 MiB cap text says it bounds what an archive may inflate to. For zip it applies per wanted entry. Say that precisely. Update docs/hooks.md where it describes the text growth rules if 1 to 3 change them.
